description: Figure 6 illustrates the distribution of deceived conversations across several scenarios. The horizontal axis represents the number of conversations, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60 and tick marks at intervals of 10. The vertical axis displays the scenarios, labeled as “Academic Collaboration,” “Recruitment,” and “Journalism,” listed in that order from bottom to top. For each scenario, there are three bars representing the proportion of conversations categorized as “Not Deceived,” “Partially Deceived,” and “Deceived.” The bars are stacked, with “Not Deceived” forming the base, “Partially Deceived” stacked on top, and “Deceived” forming the top layer. For Academic Collaboration, the “Not Deceived” portion is approximately 50%, “Partially Deceived” is around 25%, and “Deceived” is roughly 25%. For Recruitment, “Not Deceived” is approximately 60%, “Partially Deceived” is around 20%, and “Deceived” is roughly 20%. Finally, for Journalism, “Not Deceived” is approximately 30%, “Partially Deceived” is around 30%, and “Deceived” is roughly 40%. No bars are visually emphasized, and the scenarios are presented in a fixed order without apparent sorting.
